Job description:
We are looking for a Speech AI engineer specializing in the field of STT and TTS for our AI team development. The desired individual must have practical experience in developing, Fine-tuning, evaluating, and optimizing Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech models, especially for the Persian language. Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Linux, and GPU is essential, and familiarity with models such as Whisper, wav2vec2, XTTS, Chatterbox, and similar technologies is considered an advantage. Experience in Streaming Audio, Real-Time Voice, VAD, Voice Cloning, and Latency reduction is an important asset. We are looking for someone who is not just an API consumer but has the ability to research, test, Fine-tune, and Deploy Speech models. Experience working with Open Source models and preparing them for a Production environment is considered a special advantage.

Company description:
We are a technology-driven group active in the field of artificial intelligence and the development of AI-based products, and we work on designing and developing smart solutions for businesses. Our work environment is project-oriented, research-oriented, and based on solving real problems, and team members will have the opportunity to work directly on the development and preparation of artificial intelligence technologies for use in real products and Production environments.
